title: Card Management: Account Maintenance and Self-Service Features
desc: Learn how to help end users keep and maintain their debit and credit card accounts by utilizing the self-service features available.
notes: Card Management is an optional product. Contact your Client Success Manager for more information.

title: Card Management: How to Setup and Activate Alerts/Controls
desc: Learn how to help end users register, activate, and set up alerts and controls for their debit and credit card accounts.
notes: Card Management is an optional product. Contact your CSM for more information.

title: Credit Score: Products & Features
desc: Alkami offers rich credit reporting and credit management solutions with end user score monitoring, credit factors, credit utilization, and educational material. These solutions provide your end users with powerful credit monitoring resources to assist them in their financial wellness journey. This course explores both SavvyMoney and FICO Score.

title: Overview of the Financial Wellness Widget With TDE
desc: Digital financial wellness solutions are evolving fast. Alkami's Financial Wellness widget provides your end users with a singular, trusted landing spot to review and manage their spending, saving, borrowing, and financial planning activities within online banking. In this course, you will learn about the features and functionality of the Financial Wellness widget.

title: Transaction Data Enrichment (TDE)
desc: Transaction Data Enrichment (TDE) auto-categorization and description cleansing turns ambiguous transaction information into clear, contextualized data. This allows your FI to extract deep insights into end user needs and behaviors, enabling your FI to improve the end user journey and drive more meaningful experiences.

title: Account Management, Protection, & Shared Access
desc: The Alkami Platform includes in-demand features to help end users manage, protect, and share access to their accounts. Payroll Distribution enables end user to conveniently manage how their payroll deposits are distributed among their accounts. Transaction Disputes allows end user to report fraudulent transactions to your FI, which you can then investigate and take appropriate action on. The Shared Access feature allows consumer end users to share customized access to specified accounts with other consumer end users.

title: Introduction to the Accounts Widget
desc: Innovative technology is proactively guiding users to achieve greater financial health. The Alkami Platform's Accounts widget allows end users to view account details, transaction history, and analytics about their accounts to help them reach their financial goals. In this course, you will learn about account types and account type classes, the end user experience of the Accounts widget, the Snapshot feature on Mobile, and more!

title: Account Aggregation
desc: With Account Aggregation, end users can add, or aggregate, accounts they have with external financial institutions to your digital banking solution. The Account Aggregation feature allows your FI to gain insights about end users’ external financial holdings to better position your institution as their primary FI and to enable targeted marketing opportunities.

title: Utilizing the Financial Health Survey Tool
desc: This resource is designed to help you learn about the financial health survey feature. In this short module you will get a general overview of what the feature is, how you can use it to benefit your FI and users, and what aspects of the survey you can customize according to your needs. You will also learn how to send the survey to your users, and how you can resend the survey if needed. Additionally, you will discover how you can use the marketing feature to target and run reports based on the financial health scores of your users.

title: Easy Navigation of the Spending Tab
desc: Your FI Admin will enjoy an overview of the functionality of the Spending Tab, how TDE works on the Spending Tab in place of a budget and various options the end user has for updating accounts and transactions on the Spending Tab to get an overview of their finances from a month through a year overview.

title: Exploring Transaction Data Enrichment
desc: This session gives your FI Admin an in depth walk through of how TDE works and what the benefit of Transaction Data Enrichment is for the end user.

title: Optimizing Credit Health with the SavvyMoney Credit Score Widget
desc: This 1 hour instructor-led course will teach you how to use the Savvy Money Credit Score widget, allowing you to see how End Users can model loans and purchases to see what effect they may have on their credit score. You will also navigate and understand the various resources and financial wellness tools built into the widget to help End Users make the best decisions to build a healthy credit score.

title: How an End User Opens a New Account in Online Banking Using the Quick Apply Widget
desc: In this 30-minute session, you will walk through the end user experience of opening an account; talking about the various products and categories available to the end user. We will show a full workflow of Quick Apply and all the spots where an SSO experience may be integrated.

title: Digital Account Opening Dashboard Overview: View, Edit, & Process Loan Applications
desc: The DAO Dashboard is a digital account opening platform that evaluates the identity and credit risk of consumers and also streamlines storing files and leaving notes. FI admin users can use the DAO Dashboard to view and process applications submitted, edit application data as needed, and communicate on orders.

title: Digital Account Opening (DAO): Customer Experience Features
desc: This course provides essential information about Alkami's Digital Banking Platform and the DAO Customer Experience features. Learn more about the product's enhancements, stepwise navigation instructions, and workflow processes.

title: Quick Apply: Admin Set-Up and End User Application Workflow
desc: The Quick Apply tab is a single source for all product acquisition interfaces in the Alkami Platform. In this course, we'll learn how to configure application fields, manage Account Type Groups, manage submitted applications, and view relevant reports in the FI Admin Platform. We'll also learn how to assist end users as they complete applications using the Quick Apply tab.

title: Quick Apply: Category and Product Management
desc: The Quick Apply tab is a single source for all product acquisition interfaces in the Alkami Platform, allowing end users to seamlessly apply for loans, open new accounts, and purchase additional products such as credit cards and insurance. In this course, we'll learn how to set up and customize the Quick Apply tab, including adding and managing Category Groups, Categories, and Products within the FI Admin Platform.

title: Auto Billing Operations
desc: This course will teach you how to operate the auto billing system for your business customers. You’ll learn how to identify FI billing systems and methods, manage billing events, manage price lists, generate and view billing files, and download billing reports.
notes: Auto Billing is an optional product and is available on all cores.

title: Business ACH Essentials: Roles, Settings, Templates, and Payees
desc: In this course, you’ll gain an understanding of the ACH system and the roles of different participants. You’ll also learn how to adjust settings in the FI Admin Platform to enable the Business ACH widget for business users. Finally, you’ll learn how to assist business users as they create, edit, and delete ACH templates and payees.

title: Business Admin Features: Sub Users, Roles, Payees, and Payments
desc: Discover how to manage sub users, roles, payees, payment methods, and payment requests in this course.

title: Business Reports Essentials: How to Access, Create, and Edit Reports
desc: This course will teach you the fundamentals of managing business reports for your business customers. You’ll learn how to print and export reports, filter and customize reports, analyze reports, access Standard Reports, and create, edit, and delete Custom Reports. You’ll also learn how to assist business users as they complete tasks in the Business Reports widget.
notes: The Business Reports widget is an add-on product.

title: Business Wire Transfers Essentials: How to Customize, Process, and Support Wire Transfers
desc: This course will teach you how to manage wire transfers for your business customers. You'll learn how to customize and configure business wire transfer settings, process wire transfer requests submitted by business users, and assist business users as they manage payees and payment methods.

title: Supporting Business End Users: Registration, Alerts, and Profile Options
desc: Learn how to register and support business users, manage alerts, and user exclusive profile features in this course.

title: Supporting Business Users with ACH Transactions and Requests
desc: This course will teach you how to manage ACH transactions for your business customers. You'll learn how to set Risk Scoring configuration parameters, process ACH requests submitted by business users, and assist business users as they complete tasks in the Business ACH widget.

title: Using the Business Overrides
desc: Learn how to override package settings in the Business Info and Features & Access sections of the User Profile. In addition, this learning resource will teach you how to access the business overrides on the user profile, its purpose, and use cases with examples. Lastly, you will learn about options for configuring packages via business override.

title: Authorizing Transactions with the Business Admin Widget Authorization Tab
desc: In this 30-minute session, you'll explore how to authorize subusers' transactions across all money movement options within the platform, including ACH, wires, and both internal and external transfers. You'll also learn which users have access to the Authorization Tab, who can authorize transactions, and how alerts are triggered by rejections or authorizations. Additionally, you'll understand what causes transactions to expire.

title: Building Business Banking Packages
desc: In this 60-minute session, you’ll learn how to create and manage business banking packages tailored to small, mid-market, and commercial clients. You’ll understand how to automatically assign the correct package to the right business users based on predefined rules and handle package deletions efficiently.

title: Configuring Setup and Overrides for the Master User in the Admin Console
desc: In this 35-minute session, you'll learn how to configure specific functionality and apply overrides on the Business User's customer profile in the Admin Console. You'll explore how to add ACH transaction types, set up additional payment companies, and manage key overrides like billing type, package widget permissions, and business limits.

title: Creating and Modifying Payees with the Business Admin Widget Payee Tab
desc: In this 20-minute session, you'll learn how to create and manage payees used for Business ACH and wire transactions. Youll explore how to easily add new payees and modify existing payee details to ensure smooth business transactions.

title: Managing Subusers with the Business Admin Widget User Tab
desc: In this 45-minute session, you'll earn how to create a new business subuser from scratch or by copying an existing subuser and making updates. You'll also explore how to modify subuser permissions, authorizations, and transaction limits to ensure proper access and functionality.

title: Mastering Business ACH Submissions
desc: In this 30-minute session, you'll explore the different submission options available for Business ACH, including templates, pass-thrus, and Quick ACH. You'll also learn how to send various ACH batches through the system and navigate the Scheduled and History tabs. Additionally, you'll get a brief overview of the Over Limit Request options for business users.

title: Navigating and Managing the Business Wires Tab
desc: In this 30-minute session, you'll learn how to navigate the three subtabs within the Business Wires widget. You'll explore how to send wire transactions efficiently and how to add or update payee information using the provided hyperlinks.

title: Navigating Business Reports for the End User
desc: In this 30-minute session, you'll explore the Business Reports Dashboard and its functionality. You'll also learn how to generate the Daily Reconciliation Report and guide businesses in creating and modifying custom reports to suite their specific needs.

title: Reconciling Business ACH Batches in the Admin Console
desc: In this 20-minute session, you'll learn how to process Business ACH batches in the Admin Console and follow steps to create a NACHA-formatted Fed file. You'll also explore the Business ACH settings to ensure a smooth reconciliation process for financial institutions.

title: Reconciling Business Wire Transactions in the Admin Console
desc: In this 20-minute session, you'll learn how financial institutions process wire requests and create Fedwire-formatted files. You'll also explore the business wire reconciliation features in the Admin console to ensure accurate and timely wire processing.

title: Business Limit Management Setup in the Admin Console
desc: In this 35-minute session, you will gain practical skills to streamline and automate limit management for business wires, ACH transactions, and message centers. This session will show you how to manage and update staff admin roles to ensure efficient access control and responsibilities. You will discover how to enable limit increases for business ACH and wire transactions, both at the package level and within the master user profile. You will explore how to configure message queues for staff admins. You will learn how to customize site text to improve user experience and provide clarity in communications. You will understand how to update price lists to charge for limits functionality, if applicable.

title: Customizing Your Theme With Theme Builder
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: The Theme Builder is a self-service application that enables your FI to update the theme of the Alkami Platform for your end users. Your FI can update themes at any time and have the changes go to Staging in under an hour. There is currently no limit to the number of themes that your FI can create, all at no additional cost.

title: Secure Message Center: Features & Functionality
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this course, you will learn how to communicate with your end users and other FI admin users using the Secure Message Center. You will learn how to create and assign message queues, create message templates, configure SLA settings, send and respond to messages, view and download attachments, and organize the Message Center. You will also learn how to support your end users with their messages.

title: Executing Bulk User Operations
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: The Bulk Operations feature is used to enable, disable, or delete groups of registered end users from the Alkami Platform. This course will provide your FI with best practices and instructions to successfully execute bulk user operations.

title: Chat: Features & Integrations
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Chat integrations help your financial institution (FI) connect with and engage end users via Chat, Messaging, Voice, Video, and AI, and guide them on-screen within the Alkami application using CoBrowsing. This will help your FI’s customer service representatives assist in quickly resolving issues without end users having to call into your FI’s customer service centers.

title: Managing Your FI Admin Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: This course will show you how to manage who can access and perform different tasks on the platform. You will learn how to create FI admin roles and assign permissions, understand what access each permission level gives, add and manage FI admin users, view and edit FI admin user information, and reset FI admin user passwords.

title: Registering & Supporting Retail End Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: The Alkami Platform's customer service solutions allows your FI to provide first-class digital experiences and support for your end users. This course will walk you through the features and functionality of the Support menu in the FI Admin Platform.

title: General Settings in the FI Admin Platform
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: This course will show you how to access and modify the general settings of your financial institution in the FI Admin Platform. You will learn how to view and edit your FI’s basic information, such as name, address, phone number, and email. You will also learn how to update your FI’s site and mobile logos.

title: Mappings in the FI Admin Platform
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: This course will teach you how to set up and manage accounts and transactions in the FI Admin Platform. You will learn how to configure Account Types and Account Type Classes, create Savings Goal Categories, add Transaction Category Classifications (if needed), and configure Transaction Types and Transaction Codes.

title: Utilizing the Secure Forms Builder
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Secure Forms Builder enables your FI to create custom forms for your end users to complete and submit. In this course, you will learn how to utilize the Secure Forms Builder in the FI Admin Platform.

title: Airship and Gimbal Messaging: Registration, Setup, and Targeting Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Alkami partners with Airship and Gimbal by Infillion to allow your financial institution (FI) to produce marketing campaigns to promote financial products and services through in-app messaging and push notifications. Airship and Gimbal provide your FI the ability to design vivid, interactive, and unique push notifications and in-app messaging to send to your end users related to geolocations and marketing activities.

title: User Sentiment (Alchemer) Mobile Features to Collect End User Feedback on Your Mobile App
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Do you love our app? One simple question can gauge user sentiment and gather valuable feedback to use as a starting point for further user engagement. This course will teach you how to use Alchemer's features to enable users who love your app to spread the word, and to start conversations with those who aren't satisfied and use insights gained from their feedback to transform your toughest critics into raving fans.

title: Customizing Navigation With Navigation Builder
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: The Navigation Builder is an experience in the FI Admin Platform that allows you to change how your end users navigate the digital banking platform. The robust tool allows you to build custom navigation interfaces and organize widgets and custom URLs in a manner that best serves your FI and its end users.

title: Creating, Editing, & Assigning Packages
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Packages consist of themes, widgets, and limits which can be configured to provide a tailored experience for specific individual groups of end users. In this course, we'll explore how to edit packages and automatically assign packages to groups of end users.

title: Skip a Payment
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Welcome to the Alkami Skip a Payment course! Learn more about how end users can skip a loan payment if approved by their FI.

title: Using the View as User Feature
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: Welcome to the Using the View As User Feature course! This learning resource will teach users about the View As User feature, including what it is, benefits of using it, and how to access it.

title: Managing Account Types in FI Admin
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: This course guides FI Admins through setting up the Account Configuration feature and managing the associated account types.

title: Building User-Friendly Navigation in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 35-minute session, you’ll learn how to create and customize user-friendly navigation menus in the Admin Console. You’ll discover how to update the appearance of navigation menus, add or move packages, and understand how navigation impacts the end-user experience.

title: Effortless User Registration & Identity Verification in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 35-minute session, you'll learn how to register users, verify their identity with Digital ID, and handle password resets—all through the Admin Console. You’ll also explore how to navigate the forgot username and forgot password workflows, ensuring a smooth user experience.

title: Managing Admin Users & Roles in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to manage admin roles and permissions in the Admin Console. You’ll explore how to create, edit, and disable admin users, ensuring the proper access and security settings are in place for each role.

title: Managing Packages & Package Assignment in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 45-minute session, you’ll learn how to create packages and set up package assignment rules to ensure the right business users are assigned the correct package. You’ll also learn how to copy, edit, and delete packages while managing package rules.

title: Mastering General Settings in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to manage institutional settings in the Admin Console, including configuring the ACH holiday calendar, managing transfer schedules, and updating location information. You’ll also discover what settings require Alkami support for changes.

title: Optimizing Message Queues, Templates & SLAs in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll explore how to update and maintain message queues and templates for the Secure Message Center. You’ll also learn how to set up Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to ensure timely responses in the message queues.

title: Managing End User Notifications in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll learn how to manage and customize various end-user notifications in the Admin Console. You’ll discover how to update notification verbiage and test notifications to ensure end users receive accurate and timely alerts.

title: Customizing the End User Dashboard
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll learn how to navigate and personalize the end user's Dashboard in the Admin Console. You’ll explore the navigation menu and discover how packages impact the options available to end users.

title: Exploring the Accounts Widget for End Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll get an overview of the Accounts widget and explore the personalization options available to end users. You’ll learn how to assist users with hiding and unhiding accounts, utilizing the search feature, and downloading or printing transaction histories.

title: Managing Alerts for End Users with the Alerts Widget
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll get an overview of the various notifications sent to end users and learn how to edit the verbiage of each alert. You’ll also explore how to assist users with setting up and managing account-level alerts, including those that cannot be turned off, and understand the timing of the three types of platform alerts.

title: Managing eDocs Subscriptions for End Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 15-minute session, you’ll get a quick overview of how an end user subscribes and unsubscribes to eDocs. You’ll also learn how to assist users in managing their eDocs preferences efficiently within the platform.

title: Managing Shared Access for End Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to create, modify, and delete shared access profiles as an end user. You’ll also explore the available permissions that can be shared on a user’s accounts and understand the steps required for granting shared access.

title: Managing the Message Center for End Users and Admin Support in the Admin Console
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how end users can access and use the Secure Message Center to communicate with their financial institution. You’ll also explore how to respond to messages from the Support Tab in the Admin Console, send bulk messages, and ensure compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

title: Navigating the End User Profile
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to navigate the User Profile in the Admin Console for retail users. You’ll explore the information available across all four subtabs of the User Profile and understand how to guide users based on their needs.

title: Personalizing Settings for End Users
cats: Customer Service (End User Experience and Admin Console)
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll explore how end users can easily edit their personal information and customize their experience on the Alkami platform. You’ll learn which information is shared with your core system and understand the various tabs in the Settings widget.

title: Introduction to the Alkami SDK
desc: This comprehensive training program is designed to equip you with the skills and knowledge needed to become an expert in utilizing the Alkami SDK for building powerful, extensible, and innovative applications.

title: Basics and Foundation of the SDK
desc: This course takes a deep dive into the foundational elements of the Alkami SDK. You will learn about key components, APIs, and tools, while gaining hands-on experience with real-world use cases. By the end of this course, you will have a strong grasp of how to harness the SDK's potential to craft sophisticated applications.

title: Using the SDK
desc: Discover how to manage sub users, roles, payees, payment methods, and payment requests in this course.

title: Application of the SDK
desc: This course will teach you the fundamentals of managing business reports for your business customers. You’ll learn how to print and export reports, filter and customize reports, analyze reports, access Standard Reports, and create, edit, and delete Custom Reports. You’ll also learn how to assist business users as they complete tasks in the Business Reports widget.
notes: The Business Reports widget is an add-on product.

title: SDK Tutorials
desc: The ability to efficiently customize digital banking for end users is critical to maintaining satisfaction and growth. Alkami’s SDK gives you the opportunity to create personalized digital banking experiences and accelerate the deployment of new features and functionalities. In this course, you will watch our live training tutorial videos explaining how to use Alkami’s SDK functionality.

title: Content Creation & Tagging for Non-Marketing Content
desc: In this course, you will learn how to create non-marketing content sets, articles, and how to use the media library. In addition, there will be instructions on how to apply content tags to articles within content sets.

title: How to Create, Manage, and Publish Marketing Content
desc: In this course, we describe the process of creating and managing marketing content, from selecting and designing the content to publishing the content to specific locations and managing different content versions. We also explain how to create User Lists and Rules to ensure the right content is delivered to the right end users.

title: How to Create, Modify, and Publish Non-Marketing Content
desc: In this course, we describe how to create and publish non-marketing content sets and show you how to configure settings within the FI Admin Platform so that your end users can easily access the content. We also explain how to create non-marketing User Lists and Rules to ensure the right content is delivered to the right end users.

title: Managing Marketing Content Through the FI Admin Platform
desc: Alkami's content management system (CMS) enables you to manage and display tailored, relevant, and timely content to your end users. In this course, we introduce you to the Dashboard, Content, and Audience Management tabs within the Marketing page of the FI Admin Platform. We show you what marketing content looks like to end users and describe several key concepts that guide how, what, where, and to whom marketing content is delivered.

title: Applying and Prioritizing Content Rules for Marketing Campaigns
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll explore how to create and prioritize rules for marketing campaigns, ensuring the right content is displayed at the right time for end users.

title: Building and Managing Targeted User Lists for Marketing Campaigns
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to create and upload user lists to target specific customer subsets. You’ll also explore how these lists can be applied across different marketing campaigns for more effective outreach.

title: Building Effective Marketing Campaigns
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll explore how to create and manage marketing campaigns to target specific areas of the platform. You'll learn to seed all the widgets with various types of campaigns to enhance the end-user experience.

title: Managing Disclosures for Legal Compliance
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll learn how to manage legal disclosures in the Admin Console. You’ll explore how to modify existing disclosures, create new ones, and track user acceptance to ensure compliance with institutional regulations.

title: Navigating the Marketing Dashboard for Campaign Insights
desc: In this 20-minute session, you’ll learn how to navigate the Marketing Dashboard in the Admin Console. You’ll explore its high-level reporting features and discover how to manipulate the fields to view insights on specific campaigns and marketing content.

title: Utilizing Header Messages for System Alerts
desc: In this 30-minute session, you’ll learn how to create and manage system alerts using header messages. You’ll explore the best use cases for header messages and how they impact the end-user experience.

title: Bill Pay: Manage Payees, Payments, and eBills
desc: Bill Pay is powerful. It allows your FI to engage with users, build a community, and gain insights into a more complete picture of your end users. Bill pay functionality is delivered via the Alkami Bill Pay widget, which allows end users to manage payees, make payments, manage eBills, and more. Alkami has API support for two industry-leading bill pay providers: FIS / CO-OP and iPay.

title: Bill Pay: Utilizing the Dashboard, Quick Bill Pay, and Security Features
desc: In this course, we'll walk you through additional features of the Bill Pay tab, including configuring Dashboard modules, utilizing Quick Bill Pay, and employing Bill Pay's security features. We will also take a look at the Bill Pay Admin functionality in the FI Admin Platform.

title: Remote Deposit Capture (RDC): Depositing Checks Electronically
desc: Remote Deposit Capture, or RDC, is a technology that allows FI's to accept electronically deposited checks sent remotely versus having the end users visit a physical location to make their deposits. The end users can take a photo of a single check using a mobile device or a business can capture multiple checks at a time for remote deposit using a RDC machine.

title: Retail ACH Essentials: Transfers, ODFI Settings and Configurations, and ACH Processing
desc: Unlike paper checks, Automated Clearing House (ACH) entries are created and transmitted electronically, making transactions quicker, safer, and easier. Using the Transfers tab, your end users can make ACH debit and credit transfers. Common examples of ACH transfers include Direct Deposit of payroll, government and Social Security benefits, mortgage and bill payments, and online banking payments.

title: Retail Wire Transfers
desc: The Retail Wires tab allows end users to transfer money via wire transfer, which offers convenience, speed, and security. The Alkami Platform provides an easy-to-use end user interface for users to submit wire transfers, while the FI Admin Platform offers an intuitive interface for you to process wire transfers quickly and efficiently.

title: Transfer Functions: How to Set Up, Schedule, and View Transactions
desc: The Transfers tab allows for the processing of one-time and recurring transfers, as well as loan and credit card payments, via your FI’s core system. End users have complete control over the management of transfers and can schedule, edit, and delete transfers on both Desktop and Mobile.

title: Zelle: Features & Functionality
desc: With Zelle, your end users have a fast, safe, and easy way to send money directly between almost any bank account in the U.S., typically within minutes. By simply using an email address or U.S. mobile phone number, end users can send money to people they know and trust. This course provides an overview of the functionality and features of Zelle.

title: Money Movement Landing Page Configuration & Use
desc: This course will demonstrate how to configure the Money Movement Landing Page within the FI Admin Platform. An example of the end user's perspective via a mobile device is also included.

title: Adding External Accounts for Transfer Purposes
desc: In this 20-minute session, you'll learn how an user can attach an account they own at another financial institution to the Alkami platform so they can transfer funds between their internal and external accounts.

title: Creating and Modifying Retail Transfers
desc: This session that explains the various ways a retail user can transfer money internally and via ACH, modify scheduled transfers and review historical transfers.

title: Retail ACH Reconciliation in the Admin Console
desc:
This is a session for FI Admins who will be responsible for creating the retail NACHA files to send to the Fed. You'll walk away knowing how to:
Understand how to batch and approve/reject ACH transfer requests from the Admin Console
Understand how ACH transfer risk is scored and where to configure the settings

title: Easy Navigation of Paymentus Bill Pay
desc: Explore the Paymentus bill pay widget while exploring the 5-tab functionality and what an end user can do on each tab (Dashboard, Smart Pay, Manage Billers, Pay Bills & Settings).

title: Let's Explore iPay Bill Pay
desc: Explore the iPay bill pay widget with a technical trainer, who will explain the 4-tab functionality and what an end user can do on each tab.

title: Client Success Fundamentals
desc: Congratulations on Your Launch! Your financial institution’s platform is now live, and you’re officially beginning your journey with Alkami’s Client Success team. Our mission is to deliver an exceptional experience and help your institution gain meaningful value from your partnership with us. In this course, you’ll learn about the roles within the Client Success team, along with key methodologies and processes that guide our approach. You’ll also gain insight into other Alkami teams that play a critical role in maintaining and continuously enhancing your digital banking platform.

title: Preparing Your Call Center for Launch
desc: As your FI completes User Acceptance Training (UAT), Alkami recommends that your call center implements a variety of best practices to prepare for launch, both from a staff and telephony perspective. This course will help your call center prepare for the increased call volume and demands of launch by proactively making technical adjustments, creating just-in-time training aids, conducting pilot tests, and learning how to troubleshoot and contact Alkami for support.

title: FI Admin Foundations
desc: Equip FI Admins with the tools to configure platform settings and support an optimal user experience; 2 hours

title: FI Admin Retail Ops & Tools
desc: Support daily operations with tools for registration, notifications, messaging, and user support;  2 hours

title: Business Ops & Reporting
desc: Enable FI Admins to support business users and configure operational settings;  2 hours

title: Marketing Essentials
desc: Typically delivered towards the end of UAT, focusing on in-platform content creation, targeting, and publishing; 2 hours

title: Alkami Platform Overview
desc: A comprehensive walkthrough of the platform—from admin tools to crafting end-user experiences. Open to anyone from your FI looking to deepen their understanding and maximize platform value; 3 hours
